findings.title: CONNECT 目标 ACL 被绕过：0.0.0.0 / 十进制 IP / IPv4-mapped IPv6 全部映射到回环，可打穿 127.0.0.1:443
findings.counterexample_cmd:
cd /home/dm/pproxy && unshare -Urn python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, subprocess, threading, time, base64, hashlib, os
subprocess.run(["ip","link","set","lo","up"], capture_output=True)
TOK="it-token-1234567890"; H=hashlib.sha256(TOK.encode()).hexdigest()
def free():
    s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); p=s.getsockname()[1]; s.close(); return p
hp,cp=free(),free()
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",443)); srv.listen(8)
def echo():
    while True:
        c,_=srv.accept()
        threading.Thread(target=lambda c=c:(lambda:[c.sendall(d) for d in iter(lambda:c.recv(4096),b"")])(),daemon=True).start()
threading.Thread(target=echo,daemon=True).start()
env=dict(os.environ,HOST="127.0.0.1",PORT=str(hp),TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=H,PROXY_SECRET="x",GATE_ADMIN_TOKEN="a",GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=f"127.0.0.1:{cp}",RUST_LOG="off")
p=subprocess.Popen(["./target/debug/pproxy-gate-server"],env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for _ in range(100):
    try: socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",cp),0.2).close(); break
    except Exception: time.sleep(0.1)
cred=base64.b64encode(f"{TOK}:{TOK}".encode()).decode()
for target in ("0.0.0.0:443","2130706433:443","example.com:80"):
    s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",cp),timeout=6)
    s.sendall(f"CONNECT {target} HTTP/1.1\r\nProxy-Authorization: Basic {cred}\r\n\r\n".encode())
    s.settimeout(3)
    print("ACL", target, "->", s.recv(200).split(b"\r\n")[0].decode(errors="replace"))
    s.close()
p.kill()
EOF
# 实测：0.0.0.0:443 -> 200 Connection Established（真实连上 127.0.0.1:443，应为 403）
#       2130706433:443 -> 200（inet_aton 十进制回环，应为 403）
#       example.com:80 -> 403（对照组，证明端口 ACL 生效）

findings.title: 首包内已含首部结束符时 read_head 截断返回，与首部同包送达的客户端字节被静默丢弃（与 199-202 行的 leftover 约定相反）
findings.counterexample_cmd:
cd /home/dm/pproxy && unshare -Urn python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, subprocess, threading, time, base64, hashlib, os
subprocess.run(["ip","link","set","lo","up"], capture_output=True)
TOK="it-token-1234567890"; H=hashlib.sha256(TOK.encode()).hexdigest()
def free():
    s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); p=s.getsockname()[1]; s.close(); return p
hp,cp=free(),free()
srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",443)); srv.listen(8)
def echo():
    while True:
        c,_=srv.accept()
        threading.Thread(target=lambda c=c:(lambda:[c.sendall(d) for d in iter(lambda:c.recv(4096),b"")])(),daemon=True).start()
threading.Thread(target=echo,daemon=True).start()
env=dict(os.environ,HOST="127.0.0.1",PORT=str(hp),TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=H,PROXY_SECRET="x",GATE_ADMIN_TOKEN="a",GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=f"127.0.0.1:{cp}",RUST_LOG="off")
p=subprocess.Popen(["./target/debug/pproxy-gate-server"],env=env,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
for _ in range(100):
    try: socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",cp),0.2).close(); break
    except Exception: time.sleep(0.1)
cred=base64.b64encode(f"{TOK}:{TOK}".encode()).decode()
H1=f"CONNECT 0.0.0.0:443 HTTP/1.1\r\nProxy-Authorization: Basic {cred}\r\n\r\n".encode()
def rhead(s):
    s.settimeout(3); b=b""
    while b"\r\n\r\n" not in b:
        d=s.recv(1)
        if not d: break
        b+=d
    return b
def rest(s,t=2):
    s.settimeout(t)
    try: return s.recv(64)
    except Exception: return b""
s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",cp),timeout=6); s.sendall(H1); rhead(s); s.sendall(b"PING"); print("A payload-after-200  echo=",rest(s)); s.close()
s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",cp),timeout=6); s.sendall(H1+b"PING"); rhead(s); print("B payload-same-write echo=",rest(s,3)); s.close()
p.kill()
EOF
# 实测：A payload-after-200 echo=b'PING'（中继正常）
#       B payload-same-write echo=b''（与首部同包送达的 4 字节被静默丢弃）

findings.title: 带长期令牌的订阅 200 响应缺 Cache-Control: no-store（响应体 username/password 即令牌，可被中间缓存落盘/复用）
findings.counterexample_cmd: cd /home/dm/pproxy && TOK=it-token-1234567890; HASH=$(printf %s "$TOK" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=39117 TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=$HASH PROXY_SECRET=x GATE_ADMIN_TOKEN=a ./target/debug/pproxy-gate-server >/dev/null 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 2; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:39117/clash?token=$TOK"; kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null; true
